Bindings for JSTypedArray.h (typed arrays + array buffers).

The JSTypedArrayType enum itself lives in jsvalueref (as in C, where it is declared in JSValueRef.h). Everything here is macOS 10.12+.

Imports

jsbase, jsvalueref
